name: Spitball
author: supercleanse
description: Records, transcribes and summarizes your calls. Spitball notices when Zoom, Meet, Slack, Teams or another call app starts using your mic, shows a record button in the bar, and saves the audio, a two-sided transcript and a summary for every call. Transcription runs on your machine with voxtype by default (Deepgram optional), with a live transcript that fills in as people talk. Summaries use any OpenAI-compatible model, a local Ollama by default.

barWidget.description: Record button that appears when a call starts: amber when a call is detected, red with a timer while recording. Click it for the menu: start or stop recording, the live transcript, and settings.
